Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

weekend — Saturday and Sunday. Example: What are you doing this weekend?
hobby — an activity you enjoy in free time. Example: My hobby is photography.
sport — a physical game or activity. Example: I do sport every week.
game — an activity with rules you play. Example: I play games with my friends.
friend — a person you like and know well. Example: I play football with my friends.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What are you doing this weekend?
• I am playing ...
• Do you want to come?
• Let's meet at six.
• I'd love to.
